overview: The Medford Climate Equity Council discussed member website profiles, summer community event outreach, and city climate initiatives. Staff also provided updates on school building energy upgrades, proposed state climate legislation, and council priorities.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The council accepted the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Website Profiles and Meeting Location
items.summary: Brenda Pike presented options for adding member bios and photos to the city website, and the council agreed to hold its June meeting in person at the library.

items.title: Community Events Outreach
items.summary: Members reviewed upcoming summer events and discussed plans to distribute outreach flyers on electrification and composting.

items.title: Electrify Medford and Composting Programs
items.summary: Staff updated the council on language translations for Electrify Medford materials and reported that over 3,000 residents have signed up for free composting.

items.title: School Building HVAC and Decarbonization Roadmap
items.summary: Staff highlighted school committee approval for school HVAC repairs, a resolution restricting fossil fuel equipment replacements, and a state technical assistance award for a 30-year municipal building decarbonization plan.

items.title: State Climate Bill Update
items.summary: Brenda Pike summarized key elements of proposed state omnibus climate legislation, including energy infrastructure permitting reforms, right-to-heat provisions, and competitive electric supply restrictions.

items.title: Council Priorities Planning
items.summary: The council reviewed a priority-setting spreadsheet to gather member input on future project focus areas.
